note: Every release that went out, oldest first, appended by scripts/verify-upgrade-compatibility.sh --emit. This list and runtime/release-baseline.json describe the same releases, so tools/check-release-history.py (run by the preflight and the release job) refuses a baseline that is not the newest entry here; the app version guard in AppVersionSingleSourceTest rejects any versionName listed here. It is empty because no signed release is known to have shipped: if 0.28.2 (versionCode 25) was distributed before this file existed, add {"versionCode": 25, "versionName": "0.28.2-fullmode", "signerSha256": ""} as the only entry and set the baseline to match.
